name: Baal Hanan
overview: The name Baal Hanan appears in Scripture as both a king of Edom and an official during King David's reign, highlighting its significance in biblical history. Specifically, Genesis 36:38-39 and 1 Chronicles 1:49-50 record Baalhanan son of Achbor succeeding King Saul of Edom and reigning until his death, after which Hadar took the throne. These passages emphasize the orderly succession of leadership in Edom, while also indicating Baalhanan's notable position within the lineage of Edomite kings.
